stop_policy: Peak-price pre-dispatch reservation under max_cny; external guard; retain every failure, unknown attempt and budget stop in the denominator.

preregistered_analysis.design: Deterministic-first hybrid: the rules answer when a root-cause rule fired and its single fixed evidence request settled a category; otherwise single-agent DeepSeek answers (after the spent request with no further request, or with its own single request when no rule fired). Routing is fixed in benchmarks/root_cause_v2_models.hybrid_route before any v4 model request.
preregistered_analysis.primary_metric: cause category macro-F1 per method over all samples, failures scored as wrong
secondary_metrics: paid requests and tokens per case
preregistered_analysis.strongest_same_budget_baseline: best deterministic method on this sealed run (same one-request evidence budget)

targets.T2: family-bootstrap 95% interval of that difference above 0
targets.T3: hybrid macro-F1 >= single-agent macro-F1 (unknown if the single run is dropped)
targets.T4: at most 1 structural failure among hybrid samples sent to the model
targets.T5: hybrid paid requests per case <= 60% of single (unknown if the single run is dropped)
targets.also_reported: macro-F1 >= 0.85 and decisive-evidence rate >= 0.90 from GOALS

preregistered_analysis.uncertainty: family-level bootstrap, 2000 draws, seed 20261024, paired differences
preregistered_analysis.no_tuning: v4 sealed split never used before; no prompt, contract, routing, keyword or parameter change after any sealed result is seen. Every result is published, including a negative one.

limitations: Same-author synthetic data; not real-ledger evidence.
Small sample: one case per family unless per_family > 1.
deepseek-flash served deepseek-flash in the development smoke; the provider may change the model behind the alias.
